items.summary: Recommendation: retain the private-preview posture and authorize only the two financially neutral, reversible actions proposed: internal links on eastcoastrappers.com and unpublished consent-aware Reddit drafts for saveusfarms.com. Do not authorize spend, monetization expansion, or public launch. Amazon supports only $4.92 commission, 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, and 6 shipped items for 2026-09-21; 629 clicks and all 28 ordered items are under tracking_id "other", so site revenue claims are unsupported. Analytics is unavailable for all 60 registry sites. AI usage cost was $745.413324 across 4,431 calls from 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-22, including 139 errors; allocation to revenue, contribution margin, and cost-to-learn is not calculable because site traffic, attributable revenue, direct infrastructure/domain costs, and experiment exposure/outcomes are missing. Minimum measurement: reconcile affiliate events to site and content IDs, restore site traffic/conversion telemetry, allocate direct costs by site, and record experiment exposures with incremental outcomes. Continue existing Great American Lakes measurement without duplicating work or claiming success.
